main_finding: Exact compact deferred syntax can hide exponential future computation. A deferred operator is not a tractable future-interface merely because its IR node is small.

external_bridge.finding: structured d-DNNF is not closed under existential quantification; there are compact source representations whose existentially quantified semantics require superpolynomially larger structured d-DNNF

next_objective: Attach an operation-capability contract to every representation package: which queries/transforms are guaranteed cheap, which are unsupported/OPEN, and which may be deferred only with explicit debt. Then attack structured-dDNNF existential quantification and cross-language escape without turning deferred work into free compression.
